changes.title: Damaged statistics cache text
changes.text: Malformed cached text now triggers rebuilding from the original history instead of displaying replacement characters.

changes.title: Removed dataset cache alignment
changes.text: Skipping a removed statistics dataset now consumes its column references correctly so later tables remain readable.

changes.title: Reuse enemy death totals
changes.text: The Home screen calculates each enemy's death total once instead of repeatedly scanning its records while sorting.

changes.title: Unused imported-ID tracking
changes.text: Removed an unused set of ranking IDs that duplicated work already performed by the actual duplicate-matching map.

changes.title: Unused run-group flag
changes.text: Removed an unused run-group field without changing ruleset detection or recorded data.

changes.title: More compact statistics Home
changes.text: Home uses relevant native sprites and tighter rows; question instructions remain available through its information popup.

changes.title: Cache and Home regressions
changes.text: Added malformed-text, raw-history preservation, removed-dataset, enemy-ranking tie and uncertainty-mark regressions.

changes.title: Actual statistics Home screenshot
changes.text: Android checks now capture the rendered sample Home in addition to testing every existing statistics screen and dialog.

changes.title: Verified playback and audit record
changes.text: Recorded successful TEST76 playback checks and the next tested statistics-reliability batch.

changes.title: Developer Commentary
changes.text: I made the statistics Home more compact and removed repeated work without changing its results. I also fixed two cache-reader problems while preserving the original history.
